title: DEVOPS↔QA-001: CI Test Environments + Quality Gates
description: DevOps provides CI/CD test stages, test environments, and HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) infrastructure integrated into the pipeline; QA provides the test suites, test-automation requirements, and the quality gates to enforce. Grounded in DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.6 and QA_TEST_AUTOMATION_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4.

hil_integrated.description: Whether HIL infrastructure is integrated into the pipeline.

quality_gates.description: QA→DEVOPS: gates to enforce in the pipeline.

blocking.description: True ⇒ a failing gate halts the pipeline (release-gate enforcement).

x-macp.tier_rationale: CI test-stage integration is agent-autonomous. A blocking quality gate enforces the QA go/no-go (permanent HITL) at release time — a gate failure is not autonomously overridable.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (test-stage definition at planning; CI test-automation integration during development; release-gate enforcement)
confirm_conditions: ci_test_infrastructure declares ≥1 test_stage and the required environments
every quality gate carries a metric, threshold, explicit unit, and a blocking flag
blocking gates are wired to halt the pipeline on failure
reject_conditions: a quality gate threshold without a unit (violates §3.10)
a blocking gate downgraded to non-blocking without QA authority (bypasses the go/no-go)
release-gate enforcement requested while a blocking gate is red
counter_conditions: requested HIL environment not yet provisionable — request a provisioning timeline before committing the stage
gate threshold not measurable in the current pipeline — request an instrumentation hook first
